title: NINJA GAIDEN 3: Razor's Edge
summary: Will not start at all: "Insufficient VRAM. Please close all running applications." It is a Direct3D 9 title and CrossOver's DXVK cannot create a Vulkan device for it. Needs d9vk plus winevideo's DirectShow filters, applied to this executable only.

credits.name: winevideo
credits.note: Found why the movies never start (Wine's ASF Reader blocks its audio behind the video) and built the patched qasf, quartz and winegstreamer the fix installs (LGPL-2.1-or-later).

credits.name: d9vk by Sikarugir-App
credits.note: The Direct3D 9 the game runs on (zlib).

excerpts.to: ^  echo \"  overrides written for this executable only, into the prefix's user.reg\"
excerpts.note: The four DLLs go into the prefix's system32, its own copies kept aside, and Wine is told to load them for this game's executable only; each override is read back rather than assumed.

symptom: Will not start: "Insufficient VRAM. Please close all running applications."
cause: It is Direct3D 9 only, and CrossOver's DXVK cannot create a Vulkan device on MoltenVK, which offers neither transformFeedback nor timelineSemaphore. Its ASF movies never start because Wine's ASF Reader blocks the audio behind the video.
fix: Four DLLs in the prefix's system32 for this executable only: d9vk for Direct3D 9, and winevideo's qasf, quartz and winegstreamer for the movies. The prefix's own copies are kept aside.
